def: Having or celebrating a triumph; victorious; triumphant.-- Tri"umph*ing*ly, adv.
A plantigrade animal, or one that walks or steps on the sole ofthe foot, as man, and the bears.
The process of separation, or the condition of being separate,as of the molecules of a body.
A hand open and extended so as to show the palm.
An order of sponges having a skeleton composed of hornlikefibers. It includes the commercial sponges.

The principles of those within the Roman Catholic Church whomaintain extreme views favoring the pope's supremacy; -- so used bythose living north of the Alps in reference to the Italians; --rarely used in an opposite sense, as referring to the views of thoseliving north of the Alps and opposed to the papal claims. Cf.Gallicanism.
Of or pertaining to fratricide; of the nature of fratricide.
Arranged in four rows or ranks; as, quadrifarious leaves.Loudon.
Full of gayety. Mir. for Mag.
